numeric_policy: Source JSON types are authoritative: exact integers/booleans, no integer-to-float conversion; matching floating observations use exact float32 bits. Identity normalization alone uses semantic roles after observing actual object tokens.
animation_id_contract: Original public Sprite construction/reset/stop/terminal completion set an empty non-null ID; PlayerSprite uses that public constructor and the validated bank initializes idle. The internal clone-only constructor's transient null is replaced by CloneInto before publication and is not exposed by this bounded native presentation. Native std::string therefore represents only non-null IDs: an empty terminal ID must pass the original Player non-null test and recover idle when grounded. Idle variants remain selected; carry/holdable animations remain outside the validated bank. No nullable framework or other empty-check changes are implied.

mapped.lifetimes: SOURCE Level/Player/Sprite/Hair reference identities bind to actual native session/player construction tokens and presentation construction token plus sprite/hair member storage. Native world/collision/Solid/Grid addresses must independently remain stable. Actual room object construction tokens bind once to authored room/entity roles; recreation/aliasing rejects. Spring attachment must reference the actual retained Solid. The actual outgoing unique_ptr must exist exactly during the loaded coroutine stage and be released at completion; hidden retention is rejected independently of roster visibility.
mapped.rng: Complete outer 58-word RNG state is hashed with SOURCE serialization; actual call counts/events and initial/incoming room-seed constructor scopes are compared. Seeds derive from pinned authored room names, never fixture outcomes.
mapped.room_objects: Ordered live Player/Scene.HelperEntity/Wind/Spikes/JumpThru/Strawberry/Spring roles, positions, active flags and tags; spike/platform Image counts, Strawberry wobble and Spring idle wiggler counter. The componentless helper originates in the original Scene constructor, not an authored decoration. Roster removal and collider removal are independently compared; post-removal managed GC retention is not emulated.
mapped.input: Actual sampled digital button sets, MoveX/MoveY, raw aim axes, Jump/Dash check/pressed/released/buffers and Climb. Player normalizes its aim separately; the SOURCE VirtualJoystick input observation is raw. SOURCE authored key-array ordering is wire representation, not keyboard state.

additional_constructor_data_constraints: Room collider boxes and JumpThru safe=true are derived from pinned authored object sizes and the already-executed original Spikes/JumpThru/Spring/Strawberry constructor spans. Native values come from the actual Body/Hitbox/safe-ground list. These are separately identified constructor/data constraints, NOT claimed as newly recorded private SOURCE fields. Native physics bounds also must equal the recorded SOURCE Level bounds, independently of native room metadata.

named_source_representation_leaves.entities.Scene.HelperEntity/WindControll: Every live SOURCE scene reference must equal the observed Level identity. Native roster entries come from the actual current/outgoing session-owned RoomRuntime and actual persistent Player. The separate outgoing unique_ptr invariant verifies retirement rather than emitting a fabricated C# scene reference.
named_source_representation_leaves.entities.non-Strawberry.strawberryWobble: These reflected non-applicable private fields must be null, not silently ignored values. Unknown entity/component/coroutine/iterator leaf names reject for a new fidelity decision.
named_source_representation_leaves.transition.identity: Bound to real native Coroutine owner construction token, not copied C# ID text.
named_source_representation_leaves.transition.iterator.state: Only observed compiler states 0/2 map to created/moving. Any new state rejects. All meaningful camera/player/removal locals remain compared.
named_source_representation_leaves.transition.iterator.transitionOut/transi: Only null/empty lists are supported; a listener rejects rather than silently omitting a callback. This catalog has no TransitionListener-producing object kind.
named_source_representation_leaves.entities.Player.components.PlayerHair/Pl: Managed component-container representation is not emulated. Player/hair/sprite lifetimes, ownership, state machine values, respawn phase, exact hair and body state, physics, input and counters are compared at semantic boundaries. Nonempty follower transfer, water/wind interactions and additional source states are outside this catalog, not full component-system parity.
named_source_representation_leaves.entities.Spikes.components.LedgeBlocker/: Managed component wrappers are not emulated; actual native spikes, collision order, lethal checks, climb blocking and static world ownership drive gameplay. Moving/replaced global geometry is rejected.
named_source_representation_leaves.entities.Spring.components.PlayerCollide: Native Spring collider, actual Solid attachment and idle wiggler value are retained. Player contact and Puffer/holdable entity materialization are unsupported throwing boundaries, never neutral collision callbacks.
named_source_representation_leaves.entities.Strawberry.components.PlayerCol: Native collection contact throws. No follower exists in this route. Native idle sprite/light/wobble advancement is implemented; the first pulse at animation frame35 throws outside the bounded recording. No collection/follower system acceptance is claimed.

named_opaque_graphics_leaves.entities.Scene.HelperEntity/WindControll: Entity drawing visibility is a named graphics leaf, not an update or collision gate. SOURCE type remains checked as bool; native room objects do not pretend to implement their render lifecycle. Active, Tag, Collidable, position, actual ownership and all recorded Player animation/hair observations remain separately compared.
named_opaque_graphics_leaves.entities.BackgroundTiles: TileGrid artwork and drawing omitted; bounded global collision mask is separately materialized and verified from the same pinned two-room data.
named_opaque_graphics_leaves.entities.ParticleSystem: Rendering/storage of the three graphics particle systems is not part of this CPU tracer. All reached emitter RNG consumption remains compared.
named_opaque_graphics_leaves.entities.TotalStrawberriesDisplay: HUD graphics/StrawberriesCounter omitted; save/session gameplay counters remain compared.
named_opaque_graphics_leaves.entities.SolidTiles.components.TileGrid/: Render components omitted, not the collision Solid/Grid. Actual native collision storage/origin and shared-mask provenance remain enforced.
named_opaque_graphics_leaves.entities.Player.components.Sprite/Vertex: Only these named graphics components' managed IDs/visibility/container metadata are omitted. Player body/hair state is not omitted. Extra native destination sprite/light observations are retained raw but are not falsely labelled SOURCE-recorded private fields.
named_opaque_graphics_leaves.rng.bootstrap.first-temporary-scope: 3337 original TileBake/autotiler graphics choices are not executed by the CPU mask consumer. SOURCE TileBake scope remains immutable; restored outer RNG full state and the separate room1/room2 constructor scopes are compared.

source_only_guard: Every SOURCE nativeAttempts observation must remain exact integer0 and the immutable raw SOURCE comparator still checks all7915records. C++ does not execute that managed resolver. Native unsupported Spring/Strawberry/death guards are separate actual negative API executions, not invented C# native-attempt counters.
limits: No complete C# field/container equivalence, rendering, GPU, VPK, physical, full Engine/MInput or full Room2 acceptance.
Death reset is dynamically zero-to-zero; original/native assignments are present but nonzero history is not demonstrated.
Dash/freeze crossing, Room2 death/reload, Spring contact, berry collection and Puffer/holdable materialization remain unsupported.
